note: outside the 12 cells: 本町 観音寺 (海岸山, 天台宗, 気仙沼市本町1-4-16) at the foot of the cemetery slope. The GSI Anno facility 観音寺 (sym null, text point (-794.5, 228.4)) is the label of the whole precinct; the footprint snapper put it on lot /25068/324, a 24 x 6 m building on the cemetery slope 175-200 m north of the temple, so search, labels and the sign named the wrong building. Google Earth 2026-03-11 pins 'Kanonji Temple 海岸山 観音寺' and 'Kannonji Temple Kannondo 観音寺観音堂' at about (-789..-808, 403..405) in the c5 and c9 r1003 top captures, over the red-roofed temple halls; that is lot /25069/65 (695 m2, kind temple). 観音寺観音堂 (about (-818, 397)) has no footprint of its own and is not added as a lot.
